abstract: Structural analysis of the sugar chains of human chorionic gonadotropin (hCG) has revealed that abnormal biantennary structures appear specifically on hCG in the urine of choriocarcinoma patients. However, the enzymatic and molecular mechanisms of the biosynthesis of abnormal biantennary sugar chains have not yet been elucidated. In this report, the enzyme activities and the expression levels of mRNAs of N-acetylglucosaminyltransferases (GnT)-I to -V, beta-1,4-galactosyltransferase, and alpha-mannosidase II in normal human placentae and three human choriocarcinoma cell lines were investigated. GnT-IV activities in choriocarcinoma cell lines were increased from 16- to 66-fold and GnT-III activity was increased from 15- to 25-fold as compared with those in human placentae, whereas other enzyme activities were not increased significantly. The mRNA expression levels generally correlated with their enzyme activities. Among the two GnT-IV genes found in human tissues only GnT-IVa gene was strongly expressed in the cancer cells: from three to seven times as much as in the normal tissue, whereas that of GnT-IVb remained constant. On the basis of these results, we proposed that ectopic expression of GnT-IVa gene should occur along with the malignancy of trophoblastic tissues, and that the increased GnT-IV activity should be the main cause of the formation of abnormal biantennary sugar chains in choriocarcinoma. A possible enzymatic basis of the biosynthesis of abnormal biantennary sugar chains is discussed.
abstract_ja: ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)の糖鎖構造解析から、絨毛癌患者の尿中hCGには異常な二分岐構造が特異的に出現することが明らかになっている。しかし、この異常な二分岐糖鎖の生合成に関わる酵素的・分子的機序は解明されていない。本報告では、正常ヒト胎盤と3種類のヒト絨毛癌細胞株において、N-アセチルグルコサミン転移酵素(GnT)-I〜-V、β-1,4-ガラクトース転移酵素、α-マンノシダーゼIIの酵素活性とmRNA発現量を検討した。絨毛癌細胞株ではGnT-IV活性が正常胎盤の16〜66倍、GnT-III活性が15〜25倍に増加したが、その他の酵素活性は有意な増加を示さなかった。mRNA発現量は概ね酵素活性と相関した。ヒト組織に存在する2種類のGnT-IV遺伝子のうち、GnT-IVa遺伝子のみががん細胞で強く発現しており、正常組織の3〜7倍であったが、GnT-IVb遺伝子は変化しなかった。これらの結果から、栄養膜組織の悪性化に伴ってGnT-IVa遺伝子が異所性に発現し、絨毛癌における異常な二分岐糖鎖形成の主因はGnT-IV活性の増加であると考えた。異常な二分岐糖鎖の生合成に関する酵素的基盤について考察する。
